field_semantics.filled_by: 'fetcher' = valore numerico strutturato, valutato deterministicamente. 'pending_reasoning' = testo libero, richiede lettura/interpretazione da parte di un reasoning engine.

quality_flag.IPOTESI_DI_LAVORO: Plausibile, non confermato da fonte indipendente
quality_flag.SMENTITO: Dato precedente confutato da fonte verificata
quality_flag.CLASSIFICATO_AI: Area assegnata da un modello AI di smistamento (feed generalista).
quality_flag.FALLBACK_NO_AI: Area assegnata da regola (area fissa del feed o parole chiave) perche' l'AI non era disponibile: non verificato.

source_status_values.empty: Fonte valida ma senza notizie nel periodo (non e' un guasto).
source_status_values.throttled: Fonte volutamente non interrogata in questo run per rispettare i limiti del servizio (non e' un guasto).
source_status_values.error: Fonte guasta o bloccata: i suoi eventi mancano.
source_status_values.ai_unavailable: Smistamento AI non disponibile e nessun fallback: le notizie di questa fonte sono perse.
source_status_values.degraded_fallback: Alcune notizie senza smistamento AI completo (area da regola o scartate).

alert_level.WATCHLIST: Sotto soglia di monitoraggio ma in avvicinamento (>=70% della soglia).
alert_level.ATTIVO: Soglia di monitoraggio superata — evento rilevante confermato.
alert_level.ALLERTA_MAX: Soglia di allerta massima superata — priorità assoluta nel report.

field_semantics.threshold_triggered: true se alert_level è ATTIVO o ALLERTA_MAX.
field_semantics.tier: 1 = fonte istituzionale/primaria obbligatoria. 2 = fonte secondaria, ammessa con segnalazione esplicita.

report_construction_rules: Includere sempre: ogni evento con alert_level ATTIVO o ALLERTA_MAX, indipendentemente dall'area.
Includere: eventi pending_reasoning il cui contenuto testuale suggerisce escalation, anche senza soglia numerica — vanno letti e valutati, non scartati automaticamente.
Scartare/riassumere in una riga sola: eventi INATTIVO privi di rilevanza contestuale (es. sismicità di fondo sotto soglia, comunicati istituzionali di routine).
Collegare causalmente eventi correlati tra aree diverse quando plausibile (es. B1 geopolitica -> B6 energia -> B7 mercati) invece di elencarli come fatti isolati.
Se un record source_status riporta status 'error' per una fonte tier 1, questo VA segnalato esplicitamente in apertura di report — non va ignorato silenziosamente.
Finestra di riferimento raccomandata: rolling 48h dal timestamp extracted_at più recente nel file, salvo diversa richiesta esplicita.
In caso di dati contrastanti tra fonti, segnalare il conflitto esplicitamente invece di produrne una media o sintesi che lo nasconda.

Il record source_status contiene data_quality (COMPLETE | DEGRADED | PARTIAL | CORRUPT_SUSPECT), data_quality_reasons, blind_areas, failed_sources, degraded_sources. Leggerlo SEMPRE prima di scrivere il report.
Se data_quality e' diverso da COMPLETE il report DEVE aprire con una riga 'QUALITA' DATI: <livello>' seguita dai motivi, dalle fonti non disponibili e dalle aree cieche.
Per le aree cieche e per le fonti non disponibili NON scrivere 'nessun evento' o 'nessuna novita': scrivere 'non osservabile (fonte non disponibile)'. L'assenza di dati non e' assenza di eventi.
Con DEGRADED o PARTIAL abbassare esplicitamente la confidenza di ogni incrocio causale che coinvolge un'area cieca o una fonte non disponibile, e dirlo.
Con CORRUPT_SUSPECT NON produrre previsioni ne' incroci causali: dichiarare che il file non e' affidabile e invitare a riscaricarlo dopo il prossimo ciclo di raccolta.
Gli eventi con quality_flag FALLBACK_NO_AI hanno l'area assegnata da una regola e non dall'AI: trattarli come non verificati.

B6.name: Sicurezza Energetica e Continuita dei Servizi Essenziali
B6.note: Famiglia causale distinta da B1 (geopolitica = causa) e da B4 (cibo/acqua = altro bene essenziale). B6 monitora la continuita dei servizi energetici come bene essenziale a se stante: riserve, prezzi, segnali di razionamento industriale o civile.

B7.name: Economia e Mercati Globali
B7.note: Famiglia causale distinta da B6 (energia = bene essenziale specifico) e da B1 (geopolitica = causa politica). B7 monitora la stabilità finanziaria e monetaria come dominio a sé: mercati azionari, valute, banche centrali, debito sovrano. Spesso è EFFETTO di B1/B6 (es. shock energetico -> inflazione -> stretta monetaria) più che causa autonoma: nel report va sempre verificato il collegamento causale con le altre macro-aree attive.

content.title: Who Runs the Ransomware Group Qilin?
content.summary: The cybercrime group Qilin has emerged as the world's most active ransomware affiliate program, claiming at least 365 victim organizations in the past three months alone. But even top Russian hackers make operational security mistakes, and the administrator of Qilin has made a few key missteps over the last decade that all point to a 36-year-old man living in St. Petersburg, Russia.

content.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
content.summary: Microsoft did another four-digit patch drop today, releasing updates to fix almost 1,100 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software. This month's Patch Tuesday addresses 63 critical flaws -- including a zero-day in Microsoft Outlook -- and comes amid important security updates from other software makers, including Adobe, Apple, Google and Mozilla.

content.title: Want to Rent an Internet Address at the White House?
content.summary: Several staffers at the White House are using computers or mobile devices equipped with residential proxy services that render their internet address available for others to rent, security experts warned today. One of the proxy services is a Russian company whose founder's web hosting business was ground zero for cyberattacks against election systems in Arizona and Illinois in 2016.

content.title: Tech Firms Dismantle Botnet That Turned 1.3M TV Boxes Into Proxies
content.summary: Google said today it worked with industry partners to dismantle a botnet made up of more than 1.3 million Android TV set-top boxes that ship with malicious software which secretly rents the user's Internet connection out to strangers and conducts advertising fraud. Experts involved in the takedown say the action is likely to sever the botnet's access to more than 10 million additional compromised systems, including other Internet of Things (IoT) products such as Android-based healthcare devices

content.title: Widespread PHP Flaw May Cause Many Site Outages Today
content.summary: Expect to see quite a few websites serving "404" or "Page Not Found" errors today: Nearly 70 percent of websites need to update their core software to fix a pair of vulnerabilities that allow an attacker to seize full control over affected servers. Experts say there are working exploits for the flaws, and that these critical bugs are already being exploited in the wild.

content.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
content.summary: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. Sources close to the investigation say one of the executives in the United States even helped ShinyHunters operate a website that pressured victims into paying a ransom.

content.title: U.K. Sanctions Cryptomus for RU Money Laundering
content.summary: The United Kingdom has issued economic sanctions against Cryptomus, a chameleonic cryptocurrency platform that experts say serves as a major conduit for payments related to ransomware, narcotics, darknet markets, fraud and cybercrime services that are helping Russia circumvent existing financial restrictions.

content.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
content.summary: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today's epic patch batch dwarfs September's record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond.

content.title: FBI Arrests Executive at Ransomware Negotiation Firm
content.summary: Agents with the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) on Thursday arrested the co-founder of a Canadian cybersecurity firm in connection with an investigation into the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently relieved the FBI of sensitive data on thousands of agents, multiple sources tell KrebsOnSecurity.

content.title: Hydropower generation in the Southwest fell to record lows this summer
content.summary: Prolonged drought conditions affecting the Colorado River Basin led to record low hydropower generation this summer in the Southwestern electricity supply region, which includes Arizona, New Mexico, and small parts of Nevada and California. Hydropower generation from April through August 2026 was 19% lower than during the same period last year and 28% lower than the 10-year average, according to the latest data from our Form EIA-923 survey

content.title: EIA forecasts Alaskan crude oil production to grow 13% in 2027
content.summary: After decades of decline, crude oil production in Alaska is growing, driven by two projects on Alaska's North Slope. In our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook, we expect a 23,000 barrels per day (b/d) (6%) increase in 2026, followed by a 60,000 b/d (13%) rise in 2027. At a forecast 505,000 b/d in 2027, output would be the most since 2014.

content.title: Refineries have shifted production away from gasoline to middle distillates
content.summary: Particularly high refinery margins for distillate fuel oil and jet fuel have contributed to shifts in the refinery yields of major products in 2026. Data from our latest Petroleum Supply Monthly—which includes data through August 2026—indicate refinery yields of gasoline have decreased significantly this year to support increased production of distillate fuel oil and jet fuel, sometimes referred to as middle distillates due to their relative cut points in the oil refining process.

content.title: Global refinery inputs fell sharply in the second quarter of 2026 before modest recovery
content.summary: Global crude oil refinery inputs fell by 4.8 million barrels per day (b/d) in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26), or 6%, following the start of conflict in late February in the Middle East, according to data from Kpler. Throughput then increased by 1.8 million b/d in the third quarter, primarily as refiners in the region adjusted to new trade flows.

content.title: The share of solar generation with co-located battery storage is increasing
content.summary: Utility-scale solar developers are increasingly co-locating battery storage with new solar photovoltaic capacity. As of September 2026, over 16% of new utility-scale solar capacity added this year is co-located with operable battery storage, compared with 2% in 2017, according to data reported to EIA by operators.

content.title: LNG imports make up increasing share of Colombia's natural gas supply
content.summary: Colombia is importing more liquefied natural gas (LNG) as domestic production continues to fall. A potential drought this fall and winter could limit the availability of hydroelectric generation and boost the country's demand for natural gas power generation. Colombia's government has declared a national disaster in anticipation of a drought resulting from an expected strong El Ni�o.

content.title: U.S. refineries have been running at very high rates in 2026
content.summary: The U.S. refinery fleet has run at higher-than-normal rates this year, with refinery utilization averaging more than 95% of capacity between May and September, the highest for those months since 1998. Tight global product supplies this year have boosted margins for petroleum products, particularly for diesel, incentivizing the increased run rates.
